shared_or_similar_visual_information: A shaded region with an adjacent unshaded interior cutout or excluded part. On the left, use the dark gray cap between the upper-right circular arc and the straight chord. On the right, use the gray polygon inside rectangle ABDF beneath the segments AC and CE.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: It is the quarter-sector with the unshaded right triangle removed. Right image: It selects the part of the rectangle outside the two unshaded triangular pieces.
Rationales: The shade identifies the remainder after leaving designated pieces out of an enclosing geometric area. Those pieces must be removed from the area computation in each panel.
